description.zh: 加速域名，仅支持查询单个域名。
description.en: The acceleration domain name. You can specify only one domain name per request.

descriptions.zh:
该接口仅支持日峰值带宽为1Gbps以上的用户调用，如果您符合该条件，请提交工单申请该接口的调用权限。 
- 单用户调用频率：40次/秒。
- 本接口的返回结果仅支持CDN控制台接入域名查询相关L2节点地址，DCDN控制台接入域名不适用。
descriptions.en:
This operation is available only to users whose daily peak bandwidth is 1 Gbps or higher. If you meet this requirement, submit a ticket to request access to this operation.

- The throttling limit for this operation is 40 calls per second for each user.

- This operation retrieves information only for acceleration domain names added in the CDN console, not those added in the DCDN console.
